# ProbabilityDistributionAnalysis

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The statistical examination of height fluctuations in interface models to identify universal distribution classes beyond Gaussian behavior. Critical for distinguishing between different noise regimes in in-network processing, informing robust design of neuromorphic hardware against stochastic perturbations.
